question: Should this broad Linux/Windows companion-app issue now narrow to Linux only, stay as an umbrella desktop tracker, or be superseded by separate platform issues?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 show Windows Hub is available, while Linux remains planned with competing open implementation PRs, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent tracking shape or platform architecture.

options.title: Narrow To Linux
options.body: Retitle or re-scope this issue to track only the remaining native Linux companion app, and use separate follow-ups for Windows Hub gaps.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the desktop companion umbrella until Linux lands and any Windows parity gaps are triaged here.

options.title: Split And Supersede
options.body: Create or select separate canonical Linux and Windows issues, then close this broad issue only after those links carry the remaining work.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Linux
recommendation.body: Retitle or re-scope this issue to track only the remaining native Linux companion app, and use separate follow-ups for Windows Hub gaps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, set Linux product direction in discussion, and recently touched the platform status docs that now distinguish shipped Windows Hub from planned Linux app work.
